scenarios.description: reasoning_details accumulated across two chunks are cached against the turn's tool_call id and injected into the matching assistant message of the next request; an assistant tool call with no cached id is left alone
two streams cache two entries; each assistant message receives the reasoning_details of its own turn only
a recorded OpenRouter Gemini stream with reasoning_details and no tool call caches nothing; the next request is unchanged
with an empty cache, beforeRequest leaves the request unchanged
